However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Account No. 054801003478 IFSC Code ICIC0000548 Bank Name ICICI BANK Branch address NBCC PLACE, BISHAM PITAMAH MARG, PRAGATI VIHAR, NEW DELHI 110003 . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name National Dope Testing Laboratory Account No. 054801003478 IFSC Code ICIC0000548 Bank Name ICICI BANK Branch address NBCC PLACE, BISHAM PITAMAH MARG, PRAGATI VIHAR, NEW DELHI 110003 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The selected agency shall be responsible for issuance of Appointment/Joining Letters, Ex perience Certificates and Relieving Letters, as applicable, to all outsourced personnel engaged during the currency of the contract; 2. Employees already engaged in NDTL on outsourced under existing contract shall be retai ned on a fixed remuneration basis as allowed on GeM; 3. The remuneration shall be decided by NDTL on a case-to-case basis; 4. Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 6 months or more beyond the ini tial contract duration (subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent) according to n eed. 5. The engagement of outsourced manpower is intended solely to meet operational require ments of NDTL and shall not confer any claim for regular appointment, absorption or continuat ion beyond the terms of the contract. The selected agency shall remain the employer of the d eployed personnel and shall be solely responsible for compliance with all applicable statutory obligations and other applicable regulations. 6. The position/designation of the engaged staff may be upgraded or downgraded by NDTL, a s required, on a case-to-case basis. 7. NDTL reserves the right to engage, select, replace, or terminate the services of any staff d uring the currency of the contract, as per its requirements. . 5.
